title: Third-moment radius bound and corrected W33/Q43 incidence transceiver
outcomes: Pass4951 proves 134<=rho(K)<=173. Passes4953-4955 correct the Steiner quotient from standard W33 points to the dual Q(4,3) line-intersection graph and identify maximum-cut triples as W33 points and Steiner triples as W33 lines. Pass4956 gives the canonical 24D point-line intertwiner. Pass4957 identifies the 36 Q43 ovoids with the 36 W33 spreads. Pass4958 combines point and spread incidence into the full-rank identity 18I=3Z^TZ+BB^T-3J.
evidence: Eight producer/certificate passes, focused pytest regression, shared-manuscript insertion, and corrected public pages are committed on master. The dedicated remote replay workflow was queued/unobserved at close time.
boundary: The exact covering radius is still open in [134,173]. W(3,3) and Q(4,3) are nonisomorphic at q=3 despite sharing SRG(40,12,2,4). Passes4948-4950 and Pass4959 remain independently owned and were not modified.
